title: Transient slab: centre temperature decay (analytic)
description:
A silicon slab at T_i whose two x faces are suddenly held at T_s (implicit-Euler transient heat).
Analytic centre value (image series): theta_c / theta_i = 1 - 2 [erfc(u) - erfc(3u) + erfc(5u) - erfc(7u) + erfc(9u)], u = L / (4 sqrt(a t)); late times follow the first Fourier mode (4/pi) exp(-t/tau_1).
Probes tab: the centre probe with the dashed curves centre_exact and first_mode.
Derived values tab: theta_end (t_end, ~0.4 % implicit-Euler lag) and theta_check (t_check, ~0.1 %).
Line profile tab: T_profile at t_end (Fourier modes 1 and 3; the same ~0.4 % implicit-Euler lag of the rise).

parameters.name: T_s
parameters.description: surface temperature in K held on both x faces from t = 0

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (odd cell count: the centre is a cell centre)

parameters.name: H_slab
parameters.description: slab height along y (insulated y faces: 1D)

parameters.name: k_si
parameters.description: silicon thermal conductivity in W/(m K)

parameters.name: cp_si
parameters.description: silicon specific heat in J/(kg K)

parameters.name: dt_step
parameters.description: implicit-Euler time step in s; the first-mode error grows as (t/dt) (dt/tau_1)^2 / 2

parameters.name: t_check
parameters.description: time of the derived value theta_check in s

analytic_curves.name: centre_exact
analytic_curves.expression: T_s + (T_i - T_s)*(1 - 2*(erfc(L_slab/(4*sqrt(a_diff*t))) - erfc(3*L_slab/(4*sqrt(a_diff*t))) + erfc(5*L_slab/(4*sqrt(a_diff*t))) - erfc(7*L_slab/(4*sqrt(a_diff*t))) + erfc(9*L_slab/(4*sqrt(a_diff*t)))))
